cross_review_and_corrections: Prepared cowhide kit assembly cannot establish free-pattern cutting or skiving technique.
EBS episode2 contains transfer, cutting, skiving, gluing, final trimming and punching; no unsupported fold-every-side construction claim is carried forward.
ASR misrecognitions of leathercraft, skiving, stitching and materials corrected by creator titles and authored on-screen labels where available; uncertain chemistry/numerics omitted.
The 1–1.2mm EBS edge-skiving example is not a universal completed-edge target.
TY foam-volume example is not Salpa/Texon identification or an exact bulge-height formula.
Plane-side taper and thickness skiving are distinct.
EBS rubbing edge treatment and kit thread-end heating do not constitute a multi-layer edge-paint lesson.
Saddle-stitch front/back difference is specific to demonstrated sequence; photo-product thread dimensions require separate evidence.
application: New generic craft workflow manual. Private product-specific handoff kept separate.
not_run: Card insertion/fit and repeated bending or wear tests
privacy: No source video/audio/transcript/capture, private measurements/photos/models or local paths republished.
